solutions.name: BrainSAIT Provider Registry (BPR) — Solutions Ready
solutions.tagline:
BrainSAIT Provider Registry (BPR)
 A Saudi healthcare provider identity, verification, interoperability, and discovery registry. BPR is designed for clinics, ho
solutions.description:
BrainSAIT Provider Registry (BPR)
 A Saudi healthcare provider identity, verification, interoperability, and discovery registry. BPR is designed for clinics, hospitals, healthtech founders, and healthcare ecosystems that need structured provider identity with governance and interoperability readiness.
 Core identity model

 Human-readable Saudi Provider ID (SPID).
 BrainSAIT OID under the enterprise root 1.3.6.1.4.1.61026.
 FHIR Practitioner identifier.
 Optional DID and QR-verifiable public profile.
 Registry, verification, provenance, organization, location, endpoint, and credential-aware architecture.

 Important boundary
 BPR is a BrainSAIT identity and verification infrastructure product. It does not replace official Saudi professional licensure. SCFHS remains the independent credential authority.
 Live reference
 Open registry.brainsait.org
 Investment
 Solutions Ready deployment: 24,000 SAR.
 Recommended path: start with BUILD Sprint if you need scope, workflow, and deployment planning first.

 سجل مزودي الرعاية الصحية من BrainSAIT هو بنية هوية وتحقق واكتشاف وتكامل لمقدمي الخدمات الصحية في السعودية، مع معرف SPID، ومعرف OID، ومعرف FHIR Practitioner، وملف عام قابل للتحقق عبر QR. لا يستبدل الترخيص المهني الرسمي، وتبقى الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية هي جهة الاعتماد المستقلة.
